descriptor.name: NC OneMap statewide parcels — statewide
descriptor.licenceNote: Source conditions are informational; users choose their source and intended use.
descriptor.operator: NC OneMap / NC Center for Geographic Information and Analysis; county parcel data
descriptor.scope: North Carolina statewide parcel polygons, all 100 counties. nparno is the NC OneMap statewide key: five-digit state+county FIPS, an underscore and the county parcel number.
caveats: Native-ID IN predicates on this service take seconds per request (32 IDs: 10.6 s; 10 IDs: up to 3.7 s; 5 IDs: up to 3.9 s on 2026-10-12, Greensboro), so ID reads use batches of 5, matching the existing Wake County entry on the same service.
Some counties publish exact duplicate rows with identical geometry for one nparno (observed in Mecklenburg County); they collapse to one parcel. Distinct geometries under one nparno fail.
Same NC1Map_Parcels service as us-nc-wake-raleigh-parcels (served there from services.gis.nc.gov with stcntyfips=37183 and key parno); Wake County parcels would exist under both namespaces.
Layer also publishes owner, mailing address, sale and value fields, which are not requested.
descriptor.attribution: NC OneMap, NC Center for Geographic Information and Analysis, and North Carolina counties. Adapted to WGS84.

jurisdiction.basis: NC OneMap publishes NC1Map_Parcels as the statewide parcel layer; all 100 county FIPS codes present on 2026-10-12.

evidence: NC OneMap publishes NC1Map_Parcels as the statewide parcel layer; all 100 county FIPS codes present on 2026-10-12.
